explain.en: Model folders of ComfyUI Desktop. They often mix downloaded models with ones you trained or merged, so Hoardless only shows the size.
explain.zh: ComfyUI 桌面版的模型文件夹。里面常常混着下载的模型和你自己训练、融合的模型，所以这里只显示大小。

notes: ~/ComfyUI-Shared/models: current Comfy Desktop default; users can change modelsDirs in Settings > Storage (stored in ~/Library/Application Support/Comfy Desktop/settings.json). ~/Documents/ComfyUI/models: default of the legacy ComfyUI Desktop (repo archived 2026-06-26). Manual git installs keep models/ inside the repo and add folders via extra_model_paths.yaml; needs a resolver. Not installed on the maintainer's Mac.
